installation.notes: Easy install via standard unpacked extension. Bundle size ~886 KB is lightweight and loads instantly.

profile_setup.notes: Clean tabs for details and resume. Resume parser successfully extracts experience and education, and custom answers allow flexible mapping.

sidebar.notes: Shadow DOM isolation prevents target site stylesheet leakage from polluting sidebar styles. Sidebar is responsive and updates status immediately.

errors.notes: Clearly flags gated/sensitive fields. Pauses on OTP. Needs better user-facing alert notifications for timeout/parsing failure.

progress.notes: Shows active step, items filled, and items remaining. Transparent execution logs.

accessibility.notes: Good contrast, semantic markup, keyboard accessibility support.

contrast.notes: Modern high-contrast theme, dark mode compatible, fits within Chromium standard panel.

store_policy_flags: broad_host_permissions: <all_urls> permission requested, which triggers manual Chrome Web Store review.

improvements.recommendation: Split core/src/storage.ts into browser/node variants to remove Vite bundle warnings.
Add IndexedDB storage adapter for local database tables (applications, learned log, audits) to replace chrome.storage.local arrays.
Implement password vault encryption using a user passphrase before writing to extension storage.
Use endsWith() instead of includes() in OTPInterceptor isValidSender() whitelist check to prevent spoofing.
Use time-zone aware IST date calculation in RateGovernor loadState() reset check instead of toDateString().
